step 32: add the operators' keys
  keys: 2 operator keys into paisans-f2a9's authorized_keys, written as paisans-f2a9, and recorded in /srv/paisans/f2a9/.paisans/authorized_keys.owned for site prepare
  run:
    $ runuser -u paisans-f2a9 -- env -i HOME='/home/paisans-f2a9' PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/1001 DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS=unix:path=/run/user/1001/bus DOCKER_HOST=unix:///run/user/1001/docker.sock sh -c 'umask 077; if [ -L '\''/srv/paisans/f2a9/.paisans'\'' ]; then echo '\''paisans: the state directory is a link, so the keys is not written'\''; exit 1; fi; [ -d '\''/srv/paisans/f2a9/.paisans'\'' ] || install -d -m 700 '\''/srv/paisans/f2a9/.paisans'\''; exec 9>>'\''/srv/paisans/f2a9/.paisans/lock'\''; flock -w 60 9 || { echo '\''paisans: another command holds the deployment lock'\''; exit 1; }; set -e; umask 077; mkdir -p "$HOME/.ssh"; chmod go-w "$HOME/.ssh"
    $ tmp=$(mktemp -d); trap '\''rm -rf "$tmp"'\'' EXIT
    $ awk -v k="$tmp/keys" -v s="$tmp/sidecar" '\''$0 == "--- sidecar ---" { out = 1; next } { if (out) print > s; else print > k }'\''
    $ touch "$tmp/keys" "$tmp/sidecar"
    $ f="$HOME/.ssh/authorized_keys"
    $ { if [ -e "$f" ] || [ -L "$f" ]; then awk 1 "$f"; fi; cat "$tmp/keys"; } > "$HOME/.ssh/.authorized_keys.paisans-tmp"
    $ mv -f "$HOME/.ssh/.authorized_keys.paisans-tmp" "$f"
    $ cat "$tmp/sidecar" > /srv/paisans/f2a9/.paisans/authorized_keys.owned.paisans-tmp
    $ mv -f /srv/paisans/f2a9/.paisans/authorized_keys.owned.paisans-tmp /srv/paisans/f2a9/.paisans/authorized_keys.owned'
  stdin:
    | ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBB bob
    | ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAICCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCC bob
    | --- sidecar ---
    | # Keys site admit and site prepare added to this deployment's user's authorized_keys: <mark> <fingerprint> <name>. site prepare removes a line only when it is marked added here and ssh.keys no longer lists it.
    | added SHA256:X75Mb3nqVpJG3UuCRMIO94EyEAtegd44QTYVIRv99HI bob
    | added SHA256:zpa+NMqw+6z5XIib6AyyKOtOnilzIda0f4kqtWRHm88 bob

present: firewall: ufw active, its default policy left to the owner
warning: delegation reaches paisans-f2a9's manager at its next start
  Its manager is running, and restarting it would restart its Docker daemon and every container in it, so admit does not. cpuset and io limits apply after the host's next reboot.
warning: watchdog: falling back to softdog
  the watchdog will be softdog. It reboots the host when Patroni hangs, but not when the kernel does, and a hung kernel cannot fence itself any other way. A hardware or hypervisor watchdog is better: enable one in the firmware or the VM's settings, and admit again.
warning: watchdog: paisans-f2a9's Patroni can reboot this machine
  Patroni arms the watchdog and reboots the whole host when it stops renewing it, which is what makes its failover safe.
warning: public ports: every local user on this host may bind ports 80 to 1023
  net.ipv4.ip_unprivileged_port_start = 80 is host wide: no user's process needs root for a port from 80 up, the deployment's Caddy among them.
warning: forwarding: this turns on routing between every interface on this host
  The site has an endpoint, so it relays mesh traffic between sites behind NAT, which cannot dial each other. The firewall's forward policy governs what is routed.
